Ștefan cel Mare founded Putna and Voroneț and ruled from medieval Suceava; all three are geographically in the region later called Bucovina. Present-day regional location is not a claim that Bucovina existed as a named medieval province. Municipality/Church sources substantiate the two foundations; Suceava municipal historical profile supports the capital and region. These concrete foundations/seat make meaningful alternatives to a generic profession or genre bridge.
